overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a highly targeted and professional academic presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon, focusing on computational social science, disinformation, and coordinated inauthentic behavior. Across a combined audience of 3,580 followers, his content consistently generates strong engagement, driven by major research announcements, software updates (CooRnet), and career opportunities. LinkedIn serves as his largest distribution channel, while Bluesky shows the highest overall audience responsiveness.

contentThemes.description: Research findings, tools like CooRnet, and methodological approaches to analyzing coordinated link sharing and information operations.
Job openings (postdoc positions), PhD opportunities, and prestigious research grant announcements.
Promoting upcoming presentations (e.g., DisinfoConf2025) and fostering academic discussion.

recommendations: Capitalize on Bluesky's highly active user base by sharing more informal, in-progress research notes and engaging directly with other CSS scholars.
Leverage LinkedIn's broad reach to amplify recruitment posts, perhaps using video or richer visual media to showcase the team's culture.
Boost Mastodon engagement by sharing technical documentation, code snippets, or user guides for CooRnet, appealing to the platform's developer-friendly community.

platformInsights.bluesky: Bluesky acts as an exceptionally conversational and interactive hub, yielding the highest average engagement rate (6.14%). Posts seeking student applications or sharing new papers perform incredibly well here.
platformInsights.mastodon: While having a smaller audience, Mastodon shows reliable interest in tool updates like CooRnet (5.64% engagement rate for the release), indicating a highly technical and specialized subset of followers.
platformInsights.linkedin: LinkedIn represents the largest audience footprint (1,850 followers) and drives the highest volume of total engagements. Major professional milestones, such as securing grants (107 interactions) and hiring announcements, are highly successful.
